description:
Become VEIKK‘s affiliate

Welcome to VEIKK's Affiliate Program! As an affiliate, you'll connect your audience with high-quality pen displays and tablets they'll love, while earning great rewards from every purchase made through your referral. Join us, and let's empower creativity and smart learning together!

What You’ll Get

Free Review Unit

Get a free VEIKK drawing tablet sample to test, review, and create content with. Shipped straight to your door.

Up to 10% Commission

Earn a competitive 5% to 10% commission on every successful sale generated through your unique referral link or discount code.

Milestone Rewards

Unlock a higher 10% commission rate and a free Pen Display (Drawing Screen) as you reach sales milestones. The more you sell, the more you earn!

Easy Tracking & Payouts

Access a 30-day cookie window and an intuitive dashboard to track your sales. Get paid regularly via PayPal or Bank Transfer.
payout_period: Commissions are paid on the 15th of every month for the previous month's approved sales.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to VEIKK! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else's referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you're not assigned a branded coupon, then you're not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may advertise the merchant's website and products across diverse online channels, including but not limited to social media (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X), personal blogs, digital art communities, coupon/deal websites, and instant messaging groups (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord).


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. If a customer requests a refund, returns the product, or initiates a chargeback before or after the commission is generated, such orders will be excluded, and the corresponding commission will not be paid out (or will be deducted from future payouts). Commissions are typically locked for 7-30 days to ensure no refunds occur before final settlement.

4. Commission Eligibility

Commission eligibility is determined based on the product category included in the order. Affiliate commissions are applicable to VEIKK pen tablets, pen displays, and product bundles that include a qualifying pen tablet or pen display.

Orders containing only accessories, replacement parts, or other non-eligible products are not qualified for commission and will not generate any commission payments.

Non-eligible products include, but are not limited to, replacement styluses, pen nibs, cables, stands, gloves, screen protectors, and other accessories purchased separately.

If an order contains a VEIKK pen tablet or pen display, whether purchased individually or as part of a bundle, the order may be eligible for commission according to the applicable commission structure.

VEIKK reserves the right to determine product eligibility for commission purposes and update the eligible product categories when necessary.

5. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


6. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


7. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate's link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There's no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


8. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: marketing@veikk.com.


9. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must comply with all applicable advertising laws. The following activities are strictly prohibited and will lead to immediate termination and commission forfeiture:

(1) Bidding on merchant-branded keywords (e.g., 'VEIKK', 'VEIKK coupons') on any search engines or ad networks.

(2) Creating social media accounts, pages, or websites that impersonate the official VEIKK brand or mislead users into thinking they are buying directly from the official brand platform.

(3) Posting affiliate links alongside adult, illegal, hateful, or low-quality/spam content.


10. Brand Assets and Marketing Materials

Affiliates may use VEIKK-provided marketing materials, including images, videos, logos, banners, and product information, only for the purpose of promoting VEIKK products through approved affiliate activities.

All VEIKK trademarks, logos, images, videos, and marketing materials remain the property of VEIKK.

Affiliates are not permitted to:

- Modify product information, specifications, or marketing claims in a misleading way.

- Remove or alter VEIKK branding elements in a misleading manner.

- Use VEIKK materials to promote competing brands or unrelated products.

- Redistribute, sell, or provide VEIKK marketing materials to third parties.

For detailed guidelines regarding the use of VEIKK media assets, please refer to the VEIKK Creator Media Kit Usage Guidelines.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to marketing@veikk.com for support.
